Method of Attack: Remote unprivileged systems connecting to public SSH ports can execute malicious code on affected systems
Malicious data hidden in files in the tests/ folder is used to modify the build process and inject a malicious payload into OpenSSH's authentication routines
Attack Vector: Compromised versions of xz/liblzma in .deb or .rpm based Linux distributions using glibc and systemd on publicly accessible ssh
Indicators of Compromise: Slow logins via SSH taking a lot of CPU
